verified_sources.source: OS Terrain 5 and OS Terrain 50 product/technical documentation
facts: OS Terrain 5 is a DTM of Great Britain
Terrain 5 is updated every three months
Terrain 5 typical accuracy is greater than 2m RMSE
Terrain 5 ASCII grid height values represent mean height across each 5m pixel
Terrain 5 GML carries metadata including location grid spacing and vertical reference system
Terrain 50 is intended for broad applications over large areas
Terrain 50 must remain a coarse independent cross-check rather than a parcel-level primary measurement source

promotion_rule: EA 1m DTM remains the parcel-level primary terrain source; OS Terrain products are independent secondary checks with scale-aware interpretation.
